'''The Tract of Makem Te''' was a large graveyard located on [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]]. 
==History==
Every [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] that died on Makem Te was given a plate that was their final resting place. Entry onto the Tract was expensive, usually running up to 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It was not only costly, but incredibly dangerous, as many supplicants who made pilgrimages across the Tract would die of sunstroke, dehydration, or [[schinga]] attack.

The process had been going on for a millennium and had produced 1.2 trillion memorial squares. The Tract was literally a checker-board of polished stone squares, each supported by a ''stela''.

Eventually the Tract covered much of one continent, being 10%{{fact}} of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface. Originally, the enormous necropolis was mistaken for an ice cap during the planet's first orbital survey.<ref name="EA" />

It was considered Makem Te's most famous feature, and was included in the list of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]] by the historian [[Vicendi]] in his [[10,000 BBY]] publication ''[[Arturum Galactinum]]''.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
